title: TinyPerformance
description: All of the performance, none of the bloat
body:
A fabric performance modpack focused on delivering the most optimal performance with some additional client-side quality of life add-ons. This modpack strives to maintain as much parity to the vanilla game as possible. 

List of mods:

- Alternate Current
- BetterAdvancements
- BetterPingDisplay
- C2ME
- ChatSigningHider
- CleanF3
- Clear Skies
